values.note: 110 modern campsites: 60 pull-through lots, the rest along the riverbank. Many are held by returning seasonal residents; waterfront sites have a continual waiting list.

sites.source: https://branchcountyparks.org/parks/angel-cove-park/ ('Angel Cove Park offers 110 modern campsites', 'Sixty of the campsites are pull‐through lots with the remaining sites located along the riverbank. The park has a continual waiting list for waterfront sites with many of the park residents returning annually to well‐maintained and highly personalized lots'), read 2026-10-25. The derived 40-ft maximum is not stated by the county; cleared.

facilities.source: https://branchcountyparks.org/parks/angel-cove-park/ ('a convenience store for campers, toilet facilities'), read 2026-10-25. The derived dump station is not mentioned by the county; cleared to unknown.

hookups.source: https://branchcountyparks.org/parks/angel-cove-park/ says only 'modern campsites', read 2026-10-25. The derived 30 A + water came from note prose resting on directory listings (which themselves disagree: Campendium claims 30/50 A full hookups); cleared to unknown.

season.source: https://branchcountyparks.org/parks/angel-cove-park/ gives only office hours (summer and winter), no camping season, read 2026-10-25; the derived value (note prose, from directory listings) is cleared.

note: Branch County Parks campground on the Coldwater River NW of Coldwater (851 River Rd), six acres; boat launch and boat-trailer storage, playground; the river gives access to a chain of inland lakes (Morrison, Randall, Messenger). The county posts no rates or season; reserve by phone (517-278-8541; parks office 517-279-9850). --Claude
summary: County page: confirmed 110 sites with 60 pull-throughs and the camp store; cleared the derived 30 A/water, 40-ft max, dump station and season (none stated by the county; they rest on directory listings). No rate, season or booking method on the county page (public park; Google listing open, 4.2 stars / 68 reviews, phone 517-278-8541 matches). Seasonal in character: 'many of the park residents returning annually', no nightly count anywhere.
flags: Mostly seasonal (long-stay test 4 unknown): the county says 'The park has a continual waiting list for waterfront sites with many of the park residents returning annually to well‐maintained and highly personalized lots.' It gives no count of nightly sites, no nightly rate and no booking method; a directory reports $40/night (June 2025). A call to 517-278-8541 is the only way to learn whether overnight sites (and how many) are sold.
Thin county page: branchcountyparks.org gives no rates, season, hookups or reservation method for Angel Cove; nothing newer found on an official page.
